question: How is the Rudra-entered goer led to the true guru?
premises: entered by Rudra-power, he desiring to go, by Shiva-will
is led to the true guru
inference: Shiva-willed Rudra-entry routes the seeker to the sadguru.
plain_english: Entered by Rudra-power, he desiring to go, by Shiva-will — for enjoyment-liberation accomplishment, is led to the true guru.
